scenicChapters.title: Lavaux Vineyard Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 44 km this is Lavaux Vineyard Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 54 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
